name: donestate
description: Proof & State's authorised execution control plane for bounded repository work, with independent OpsTruth verification.

interface.longDescription: DoneState is Proof & State's authorised execution control plane for bounded repository work. Describe an outcome, explicitly grant one consequence envelope, and let DoneState run, validate and publish only within that authority. OpsTruth is the independent read-only verification plane; DoneState never treats its own execution evidence as proof.
defaultPrompt: Implement this issue within my approved authority and open a PR for independent verification.
Maintain this selected repository with PR-only repairs and independent verification.
Show me the state of my DoneState run.
